description: Seed vulnerability mechanisms used by the offline cluster-assisted guideline generator. This lexicon constrains guideline granularity; it is not used as an online source-code regex scanner.

mechanisms.name: attacker-controlled JNDI lookup target
mechanisms.source_shape: attacker-controlled names, URLs, headers, configuration values, or lookup keys
mechanisms.sink_shape: JNDI, LDAP, RMI, naming-context, or remote lookup APIs
mechanisms.missing_guard: the lookup scheme, authority, object factory, object type, and network destination are not constrained before lookup
mechanisms.typical_fix: bind lookup inputs to trusted constants or allowlists, restrict schemes and destinations, and disable remote object factories

mechanisms.name: attacker-controlled webhook or callback URL fetch
mechanisms.source_shape: attacker-controlled webhook URLs, callback URLs, endpoint parameters, or request destinations
mechanisms.sink_shape: outbound HTTP clients, URL.openConnection, fetch helpers, proxy clients, or webhook dispatchers
mechanisms.missing_guard: scheme, host, redirect target, DNS resolution, and private-address ranges are not constrained before the outbound request
mechanisms.typical_fix: enforce scheme and host allowlists, block private and metadata addresses after DNS resolution, and validate redirect targets

mechanisms.name: SSRF through redirect-following client
mechanisms.source_shape: attacker-controlled URLs or server-controlled redirect responses
mechanisms.sink_shape: HTTP clients that automatically follow redirects or reuse a previously validated URL decision
mechanisms.missing_guard: the final redirected scheme, host, port, and resolved address are not revalidated before the sensitive network request
mechanisms.typical_fix: disable automatic redirects or revalidate every redirect hop against the same allowlist and address policy

mechanisms.name: untrusted template or expression evaluation
mechanisms.source_shape: attacker-controlled template text, expression strings, macro content, or rendering parameters
mechanisms.sink_shape: template engines, expression evaluators, macro renderers, or scriptable configuration evaluators
mechanisms.missing_guard: untrusted expression content is evaluated without sandboxing, escaping, allowlisting, or disabling reflective execution features
mechanisms.typical_fix: separate data from templates, sandbox expression evaluation, and disable reflection or method invocation features for untrusted input

mechanisms.name: untrusted deserialization with attacker-controlled type graph
mechanisms.source_shape: untrusted serialized bytes, object streams, pickles, marshaled payloads, or type metadata
mechanisms.sink_shape: deserializers that instantiate classes, reconstruct object graphs, or invoke callbacks during object creation
mechanisms.missing_guard: allowed classes, object types, and construction side effects are not constrained before deserialization
mechanisms.typical_fix: use type allowlists, safe codecs, signature checks, or data-only formats instead of general object deserialization

mechanisms.name: path traversal through missing canonical prefix check
mechanisms.source_shape: attacker-controlled filenames, archive entries, path fragments, or resource names
mechanisms.sink_shape: file read, write, delete, extraction, or resource-loading APIs
mechanisms.missing_guard: the normalized absolute path is not checked to remain under the intended base directory before the file operation
mechanisms.typical_fix: normalize and canonicalize the resolved path, then enforce a base-directory prefix or equivalent containment check

mechanisms.name: missing object-owner or tenant-scope authorization
mechanisms.source_shape: attacker-selected resource identifiers, object IDs, tenant IDs, or administrative action targets
mechanisms.sink_shape: sensitive read, write, mutation, deletion, workflow, or administrative operations on the selected resource
mechanisms.missing_guard: the authorization decision is not bound to both the current principal and the exact resource or tenant being affected
mechanisms.typical_fix: check ownership or tenant scope before the effect and carry that checked identity into the data access or mutation

mechanisms.name: request-body resource identifiers bypass path-scoped authorization
mechanisms.source_shape: attacker-controlled resource identifiers, namespace IDs, tenant IDs, object IDs, or bulk-operation targets carried in a request body
mechanisms.sink_shape: bulk updates, synchronization operations, mutations, or administrative effects that act on those body-selected resources
mechanisms.missing_guard: the body-selected resources are not validated to match the URL path parameters or the resource identity used by the authorization check
mechanisms.typical_fix: validate every body-selected target against the path-scoped resource identity before the permission check and before the mutation

mechanisms.name: missing authentication before privileged action
mechanisms.source_shape: externally reachable requests, RPC messages, management calls, or background command triggers
mechanisms.sink_shape: privileged commands, administrative state changes, credential operations, or protected data access
mechanisms.missing_guard: caller identity is not established before the privileged action begins
mechanisms.typical_fix: require a validated session, principal, token, or authentication filter before any privileged effect

mechanisms.name: missing business-state precondition before sensitive effect
mechanisms.source_shape: requests or events that select an operation, workflow step, account, resource, or state transition
mechanisms.sink_shape: sensitive state changes, billing effects, entitlement changes, resource consumption, or workflow transitions
mechanisms.missing_guard: the required lifecycle state, quota, ownership state, or operation ordering is not enforced before the effect
mechanisms.typical_fix: validate the required state immediately before the effect and make the check and mutation atomic when needed

mechanisms.name: time-of-check to time-of-use on mutable object
mechanisms.source_shape: mutable files, paths, objects, identities, request fields, or shared state that are checked before use
mechanisms.sink_shape: sensitive file, state, permission, memory, or resource effects that depend on the earlier check
mechanisms.missing_guard: the checked value is not stabilized with a handle, lock, transaction, immutable copy, or atomic operation before the effect
mechanisms.typical_fix: bind the check to a stable reference or perform the check and effect under the same atomic operation or synchronization boundary

mechanisms.name: temporary directory create-delete-mkdir TOCTOU race
mechanisms.source_shape: temporary file or directory names created in shared writable locations
mechanisms.sink_shape: manual temporary directory creation sequences such as createTempFile, delete, then mkdir or mkdirs
mechanisms.missing_guard: the temporary path is released between creation and directory creation, allowing another actor to replace or pre-create it before use
mechanisms.typical_fix: use an atomic temporary-directory API such as Files.createTempDirectory and avoid delete-then-mkdir sequences

mechanisms.name: privileged server-side capability exposed to lower privilege context
mechanisms.source_shape: lower-privilege script, template, macro, plugin, or API callers that can invoke privileged server-side capabilities
mechanisms.sink_shape: server-side include, template rendering, servlet dispatch, raw object access, internal file reads, or privileged framework APIs
mechanisms.missing_guard: a higher privilege check is not enforced at the API entry point before exposing the server-side capability
mechanisms.typical_fix: check the required higher privilege at the exposed API boundary and return no sensitive result when the caller lacks that privilege

mechanisms.name: bean property reflection escape
mechanisms.source_shape: attacker-controlled property names, bean paths, binding keys, or conversion metadata
mechanisms.sink_shape: bean introspection, property-copy, nested binding, conversion, or reflective access APIs
mechanisms.missing_guard: dangerous meta-properties, nested class-loader paths, or reflective properties are not suppressed before binding
mechanisms.typical_fix: denylist dangerous meta-properties, restrict nested binding, and avoid exposing reflective class-loader reachable fields
